hints.text: Dividing by a decimal is awkward. The problem gets easier if the divisor becomes a whole number first.
Multiply both $7.2$ and $0.8$ by $10$. The quotient does not change, and the problem becomes $72 \div 8$.

explanation: Multiplying both numbers by the same amount does not change a quotient, so multiply each one by $10$.
$7.2 \times 10 = 72$ and $0.8 \times 10 = 8$, which turns the problem into $72 \div 8$.
Dividing gives $72 \div 8 = 9$, so $7.2 \div 0.8 = 9$. Nine groups of $0.8$ make $7.2$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Ask "how many fit?"
steps: The question is really: how many $0.8$s fit inside $7.2$?
$0.8 \times 9 = 7.2$ exactly, so nine of them fit ✓
